description: Edits a survey, or opens or closes it with status. Opening makes the survey page public and lets campaigns that ask its questions be test-sent and scheduled; closing stops new answers. Questions you pass replace the whole list; keep each existing question id so earlier answers stay matched. Fields you leave out stay as they are. Sends nothing. Requires API key scope: draft.

id.description: Keep a question’s existing id when editing so earlier answers stay matched. Leave out for new questions.

options.description: Choices for single and multi questions (2 to 20).

key.description: Short stable key, for example "yes". Made up when left out.

tags.description: Tags added to a contact who picks this option.

prompt.description: The question as the reader sees it.

labels.description: Up to two end labels, for example ["Poor", "Great"].

max.description: Top of a rating scale (default 5). Ignored for nps.

type.description: rating (1 to 5 stars, or up to 10), nps (0 to 10 recommend score), single (pick one), multi (pick any), text (one line), long_text (paragraph). Only rating, nps and single can be answered from inside an email.

status.description: "open" to start taking answers, "closed" to stop, "draft" to take it offline.

survey_id.description: Survey id (a UUID), as returned by survey_create or surveys_list.

name: survey_update
title: Update survey
